story.head: Boeser’s favorite opponent
paras: The Canucks won the teams’ first meeting this season, 6-5 in overtime in Anaheim on Oct 27. The Ducks (6-7-1) beat Ottawa 6-3 on Sunday, while the Canucks (3-12-1) lost 4-2 to Toronto on Saturday. Going in, the Ducks are sixth in the Pacific (25th in the NHL) and the Canucks are last in the NHL.

The Ducks’ record (.464) is about what their chances are worth. The Canucks haven’t played well, but their record (.219) is worse than their play: their chances are worth about .311, mostly because they’re 2-4 in one-goal games.

The Ducks play some of the league’s fastest games (3rd), hit a lot (3rd) and give up a lot of dangerous shots (30th). Anaheim has allowed 3.79 goals a game, the third most in the league. The Canucks pick their shots (lowest) and have had shaky goaltending (32nd). They also have a leaky penalty kill (32nd), so the Ducks have the edge over them on the penalty kill. Vancouver has allowed 4.50 goals a game, the most in the league. The Ducks’ forecheck could keep the Canucks pinned in their own end.

Leo Carlsson (4 G / 17 A / 21 P in 14 GP) leads the Ducks in scoring and is tied for seventh in the NHL, with ten points in his last five games. Beckett Sennecke (8 G / 4 A / 12 P in 14 GP) has a team-high eight goals. For the Canucks, Elias Pettersson (#40) (4 G / 12 A / 16 P in 16 GP) leads the way in scoring, and Jonathan Lekkerimäki (6 G / 7 A / 13 P in 16 GP) has a team-high six goals.
Laurent Brossoit (1-0-0 / .864 SV% in 1 GS) is expected to go for Anaheim. Kevin Lankinen (1-7-0 / .808 SV% in 7 GS) has had a rough start to the season for Vancouver, but is expected to start.
At home, Manny Malhotra likes to send Cotter, Sasson and Gallagher out against opponents’ fourth lines, so watch for them against Malott, McQueen and Nesterenko.

items.text: Brock Boeser has a point in nine straight games against Anaheim, with a goal in each of the last three.

The Ducks are newly without A.J. Greer, and have been without Troy Terry for several games. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, no team is missing more right now.
The Canucks are newly without Filip Chytil, and have had to make do without Thatcher Demko all season. Kevin Lankinen is expected to start.
Filip Hronek is one point from 300.
